title: 800-Series Execution Roadmap — S804 Through S812
basedOn: S309 forecast + S803 post-archive state + S311 capacity analysis

phases.label: Foundation — Learner Safety
phases.description: De-certify 37 Pack A Section E Certified clone items. Remove identical-stem items from learner delivery pool. 2 batches (28 + 11). Per S803 conditions C1-C9.
milestones: M1: Pack A Section E clones de-certified
blockers: User authorization for de-certification of Certified items (C1)
phases.parallelization: None — this is a single-session phase

phases.label: Domain E Replacement Authoring
phases.description: Author 43 Domain E replacement items (1 per clone group). Certify 38 retained seeds. S805: methodology session (first 10 items). S806: Pack C/E replacement || Pack D/F seed cert. S807: Pack D/E replacement || Pack C/F seed cert.
milestones: M2: Domain E methodology established (10 items authored, quality baseline set)
M3: 20 Domain E replacement items complete
M4: All 43 Domain E replacement items authored
phases.parallelization: S806 and S807 can run parallel pairs within each session (Pack C/E || Pack D/F, then Pack D/E || Pack C/F)

phases.label: Domain F Authoring
phases.description: Author 37 Domain F replacement items. Certify 39 retained seeds. S808: methodology session (first 10 items). S809: Pack C/F replacement || Pack D/E seed cert. S810: Pack D/F replacement || Pack C/E seed cert.
milestones: M5: Domain F methodology established (10 items authored)
M7: All 37 Domain F replacement items authored
phases.parallelization: Same parallel pairing strategy as Phase 2

phases.label: Catch-Up & Consistency
phases.description: Catch-up session for any items that failed QA review. Cross-pack consistency audit. Verify no answer-key drift. Run full governance guard suite.
milestones: All Domain E/F items pass QA gates

phases.label: Closeout & Certification
phases.description: Final certification wave. Promote Certification Candidate → Certified. Recalculate Domain E/F UIQS. Refresh Portfolio Health Index. Generate 800-series completion report. Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md. Write REVISION_HISTORY.md closeout entry.
milestones: M8: All Domain E/F items Certified
M9: Domain E UIQS recalculated (target: 79.0, B)
M10: Domain F UIQS recalculated (target: 77.9, B)
